criteria.evidence: The response reasons about why the model skips the tool and ends with a debug section tying skip patterns (common-knowledge vs random) to specific fixes, but it mostly lists fixes rather than tracing the decision boundary.
It has a 'How to debug it' section (log skipped cases) and asks for a tool description and skipped-call example, but only after seven fixes including architectural ones like gating and routing.
It recommends no frameworks; the fixes are descriptions, prompts, the tool_choice API setting, and simple rule-based or cheap-model routing.
